business_summary: Scinex Corporation engages in the information media, DX support, logistics, and healthcare businesses in Japan and internationally. The company publishes My Town Encyclopedia, a regional government information magazine that connects local governments, residents, and businesses; and Telepal 50, an alphabetical telephone directory. It also offers My Town NAVI, a digital signage for government offices and large commercial facilities; My Town Portal, a city promotion site; My Town AI Chatbot, which utilizes artificial intelligence to support public services and business; e-commerce site for supporting local specialties and hometown tax donations; and Shiireru, a marketplace service that connects local businesses with e-commerce retailers. In addition, the company provides ICT business, system engineering, and system integration solutions; and My Town Pay, a digital platform app that allows to use digital tickets, as well as plans, develops, and produces digital contents. Further, the company offers logistics services to support local governments and businesses; dental services, materials, and medical equipment; and investment services. Scinex Corporation was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
